title: Antithetic scarps and buried basement steps under cover (catalogue-free)
supersedes: Nothing. H79-NHR, G79B-SDPT, G79-STEPCO and G79-FABRIC-OFFSET remain stopped negative lanes with their own cards.
lane_paragraph: The faults missing from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue are those catalogue mappers could not draw from downhill-facing range-front scarps: antithetic uphill-facing graben strands and basement faults buried under basin fill. Rank cells by (a) lidar facing-polarity asymmetry weighted by step magnitude and along-strike coherence, and (b) two-scale step-dipole persistence of depth-to-basement, isostatic gravity, RTP magnetics and surface conductivity, interacted with cover thickness. Combine the closed channel list below with one fixed HistGradientBoosting regressor trained on nested whole-component hide-and-recover 300 m kernel credit (shared gems57 split/evaluator). No catalogue-geometry feature (distance, density, tips, strike field) is an input; the catalogue is used only to define nested-hide targets, to exclude catalogue pixels from training rows, and to keep final dots off mapped pixels. Emission: shared fixed allocator, 37,654 binary dots, 3 px spacing, zeros elsewhere. No registry raster, prior submission, or overlap cap enters the surface.
hypothesis: A catalogue-free ranking built from facing polarity and cover-interacted potential-field step persistence recovers withheld catalogue faults better than the H33 fold-fair control while placing dots in terrain (antithetic piedmonts, covered graben margins) that prior amplitude/proximity dot fields underweight, passing the registry duplicate gate without capping.
mechanism: Normal-fault grabens pair a downhill-facing master scarp with uphill-facing antithetic scarps; under Quaternary fill the same structures step basement depth, density (gravity) and magnetic basement across the trace, and a through-going basement fault's step persists when the field is smoothed to ~600 m scale whereas shallow lithologic edges fade.
named_non_fault_mimic: Ridge-top sackung and landslide head scarps are also uphill-facing; unfaulted sedimentary pinch-outs and paleochannel margins step basement depth and gravity together; airborne survey levelling seams can step magnetic fields along flight lines.
excluded_inputs: No registry raster, prior submission, SGMC map, Qfaults CSV, radiometric product, DEM10 product, catalogue-distance/density/tip feature, or score is an input to the surface.
channels_closed_list: anti_asym = upface_max/(upface_max+downface_max+1) (lidar u8, valid where either >0)
upface_rank, downface_rank, step_rank, coh100_frac, relief_rank (lidar u8 ranks)

for F in {log_depth=b15, iso_grav_anom=b13, rtp=b2, cond_surf=b17}: F_step_s = step dipole (8 normals, +-3 px) on sigma=1.5 smoothed F; F_step_L = same on sigma=6 smoothed F; F_persist = min(rank01(F_step_s), rank01(F_step_L))
robust-norm raw bands: log_depth, iso_grav_anom, rtp, cond_surf, tmi_hg (b3), iso_grav_anom_hg (b18), geod_2ndinv (b4), log1p deq (b10), log1p ieq (b16), det_elev_slope (b19)

fixed_parameters.target: max(1 - d/3 px, 0) towards the nested-withheld component; context catalogue pixels excluded from training rows (identical to H79-NHR)
fixed_parameters.model: sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor(max_iter=250, learning_rate=0.08, max_leaf_nodes=63, min_samples_leaf=200, l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=seed) (identical to H79-NHR; not tuned)
fixed_parameters.placement: gems79.placement.place: descending surface, Euclidean 3 px spacing, budget 37654 scaled by evaluation-region footprint area in holdout
fixed_parameters.allowed_cells: footprint & region & not masked/visible catalogue (holdout); footprint & not catalogue (final)
fixed_parameters.final_map: model trained on nested hides of the full catalogue over the whole footprint; 37654 binary dots off the catalogue; zeros elsewhere (all finite)

holdout.split: shared gems57.holdout.buffered_component_draw, seeds 20 and 30, buffer 3 px, boundary 12 px (identical folds to H79-NHR/STEPCO/G79B so controls are directly comparable)
holdout.training_for_holdout: leave-one-quadrant-out: for fold q the model is fitted only on nested hides of the VISIBLE catalogue in the three other quadrants
controls: seeded uniform surface, same allocator and budget

h33_foldfair_control: legacy D2.8 dots outside 2 px of the fold's visible catalogue (the repo's current-holdout-best bar; H79-NHR's higher numbers belong to a stopped duplicate lane and are reported as context, not as the bar)
holdout.ci: shared paired physical 20 km spatial-cluster percentile bootstrap, 1000 draws

leakage_canary: Every channel alone on each seed and fold (shared canary): symmetric AUC > 0.90 means leakage until proven otherwise and blocks promotion.

uniqueness_rule.tool: vendor/gems57/uniqueness.py compare_array_to_registry, dot_definition budget-matched-v3, checked on the surface BEFORE placement and on the final dots (IR-79-54 sequencing honoured)
uniqueness_rule.discriminating_classification: Amendment-B1 rule already adopted in this repo (registry/preregistration_g79b_amendment_B1.json): a dot-field prior is discriminating iff its 3 px halo covers < 0.70 of the allowed domain. Discriminating priors: forward 3 px overlap <= 0.70. Non-discriminating priors (halo >= 0.70; the literal test is mathematically unsatisfiable against the 13GEMSDOE lattice at this budget/spacing — B1 infeasibility proof, IR-79-53): exact-cell dot overlap <= 0.70. Spearman <= 0.90 applies to every raster in both cases. Literal readings are published alongside; adopting B1 as the automated rule is flagged as IR-79-57 for user review and does not alter any threshold value.

promotion_gate: candidate pooled HOLDOUT-DTI > h33_foldfair_control point estimate on BOTH seeds
paired 95% CI of candidate minus uniform_control excludes 0 on both seeds

uniqueness: surface and final Spearman <= 0.90 vs every registry raster; forward 3 px overlap <= 0.70 vs every discriminating registry raster; exact-cell overlap <= 0.70 vs every non-discriminating registry raster
shared submission_writer validation: single band float32, EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, sample transform, all finite, values in [0,1], no mass outside footprint or on catalogue
if any gate fails: verdict negative, file name ends DO-NOT-SUBMIT, OK TO SUBMIT: NO everywhere
experiments: C1: the lane exactly as specified above
C2/C3: reserved; only for a defect fix, never for tuning against the holdout
score_policy: Only evaluator outputs are labelled HOLDOUT-DTI (version, withheld positives, 95% CI). No projected leaderboard score is written. ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED requires a submission-page receipt. Historical family scores in the prompt (e.g. H33 0.2778) are USER-REPORTED, not receipt-verified.
